answer: An agent marketplace requires a locked bond for every unit of voting power, so agents trading sonnet drafts, trellis designs, or saffron harvest forecasts gain no extra influence by splitting one bond across fake identities. Bonds remain locked through a challenge window, and signed evidence of double voting triggers slashing. To control a vote, an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough capital to outweigh honest bonds, while cheating risks losing that capital.
